events.name: Mrs. Doubtfire (Touring)
events.info: Everyone's favorite Scottish nanny is headed to the Triangle in this internationally acclaimed hit musical critics call "wonderful, heart-warming, and laugh-out-loud funny" (Manchester Evening News) and "a feel-good, family-friendly comedy that delivers" (The Hollywood Reporter). Based on the beloved film, MRS. DOUBTFIRE tells the hysterical and heartfelt story of an out-of-work actor who will do anything for his kids. It's "the lovable, big-hearted musical comedy we need right now," raves the Chicago Tribune - one that proves we're better together.
events.pleaseNote: Not recommended for children 8 and under. Children under the age of 6 are not allowed at this DPAC event and all guests require a ticket, regardless of age. Parental discretion is advised.

ticketLimit.info: There is an overall 9 ticket limit for this event. To purchase 10 or more tickets, please email us at Groups@DPACnc.com or call 919-281-0587.

events.info: Waiting to Exhale in Concert celebrates the music, friendship and emotion of the landmark film through an evening of unforgettable songs performed live by an all-star lineup of vocalists, Avery*Sunshine, Alexia Jayy, and Melanie Fiona, and joined by an exceptional live band led by acclaimed music director, producer and musician Adam Blackstone, whose credits span some of the biggest names and stages in music. Featuring music from one of the most celebrated soundtracks of the 1990s, the concert includes songs made famous by Whitney Houston, Toni Braxton, Brandy, Mary J. Blige, Chaka Khan, and more, including favorites such as "Exhale (Shoop Shoop)," "Sittin' Up In My Room", and "Count On Me." 30 years after its release, Waiting to Exhale remains a cultural touchstone with a soundtrack that resonates across generations. This special concert event brings that music back to the stage for a night celebrating love, heartbreak, friendship, resilience and the songs that defined an era.

events.info: GRAMMY, ACM, CMA, AMA, and Emmy Award-winning group Little Big Town?Karen Fairchild, Phillip Sweet, Kimberly Schlapman, and Jimi Westbrook?has spent 25 years as one of country music?s most successful vocal groups. They broke out with ?Boondocks,? ?Bring It On Home,? ?Good As Gone,? and ?Little White Church,? and rose to major success with Tornado and Pain Killer, producing No. 1 hits including ?Pontoon,? ?Tornado,? ?Day Drinking,? and the landmark ?Girl Crush.? Their 2017 album The Breaker featured the GRAMMY-winning ?Better Man,? followed by Nightfall and Mr. Sun. To date, they have earned over 45 nominations and 20+ wins across major award shows. In 2025, they released a Greatest Hits album featuring Kelsea Ballerini, Miranda Lambert, and Sugarland, along with their first-ever Christmas album, The Christmas Record.

events.name: Death Becomes Her (Touring)

presales.name: Greatest Hits of Broadway Member Presale

events.info: Madeline Ashton is the most beautiful actress (just ask her) ever to grace the stage and screen. Helen Sharp is the long-suffering author (just ask her) who lives in her shadow. They have always been the best of frenemies...until Madeline steals Helen's fiancé away. As Helen plots revenge and Madeline clings to her rapidly fading star, their world is suddenly turned upside down by Viola Van Horn, a mysterious woman with a secret that's to die for. After one sip of Viola's magical potion, Madeline and Helen begin a new era of life (and death) with their youth and beauty restored...and a grudge to last eternity. Now a warning! Death Becomes Her is a "wildly entertaining, perfect musical comedy" (Deadline) and "the most fun night out on Broadway!" (The Daily Beast)

events.info: Madeline Ashton is the most beautiful actress (just ask her) ever to grace the stage and screen. Helen Sharp is the long-suffering author (just ask her) who lives in her shadow. They have always been the best of frenemies...until Madeline steals Helen's fiancé away. As Helen plots revenge and Madeline clings to her rapidly fading star, their world is suddenly turned upside down by Viola Van Horn, a mysterious woman with a secret that's to die for. After one sip of Viola's magical potion, Madeline and Helen begin a new era of life (and death) with their youth and beauty restored...and a grudge to last eternity. Now a warning! Death Becomes Her is a "wildly entertaining, perfect musical comedy" (Deadline) and "the most fun night out on Broadway!" (The Daily Beast)
